item.title: Ahead of Taylor Swift’s Likely Oscar Debut, Here’s How Other 21st Century Pop Stars Fared at Their First Academy Awards
item.description:
[Intro music fades out]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the world of music and movies. Today, we're talking about the upcoming Oscar race for best original song, and one name that's making waves is Taylor Swift. Her song "I Knew It, I Knew You" from Toy Story 5 is a strong contender, given its massive success on the Billboard Hot 100 charts.
But, as we know, there are no guarantees in awards voting. Even music megastars like Beyoncé and Rihanna have gone home empty-handed in recent years. So, let's take a look at some top music stars of the 21st Century who have been nominated for Oscars for best original song.
[Short music transition]
Host: We'll be highlighting artists who debuted since 2000, with a special exception for hip-hop icon Eminem, who broke through in 1999. We'll also be sharing notes on how their nominations turned out, and if they had any subsequent nominations in the category.
[Short music transition]
Host: The Academy will announce the shortlist of 15 contenders for best original song on December 15, and nominations will be announced on January 21. The awards will be presented on March 14. We'll be keeping an eye on Taylor Swift's chances, and we'll be back with more updates soon.
[Outro music starts]
Host: Thanks for tuning in to our podcast. Join us next time as we explore more stories from the world of music and movies.
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
